newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices steady to weaker.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices steady to weaker.

text.p: Millfeed prices continued to weaken at some locations on Tuesday while elsewhere there were signs that the market may be starting to stabilise after its recent slide, dealers said.
"We have good spring weather and plenty of grass out there," one dealer said, noting prices in the Kansas City area were particularly weak.
Low milk prices were also weighing on the market in the northeast United States, as many dairy farmers relied on on-farm feed supplies.
But some dealers said prices may not fall much further.
"We're probably cheap enough," one Minnesota-based dealer said, noting there was sufficient demand in his area to mop up any unsold supplies.
Some trade at $80 a ton was reported in north Texas, where the market was holding slightly firmer than many others due to lower mill run times in the region.
